property_summary: Even when called by the authorized depositor (address(0)), setL1BlockValues in the reference never writes sequenceNumber, so c.sequenceNumber() stays 0 for every input; the mutant assigns _sequenceNumber before returning, so any nonzero _sequenceNumber from the authorized caller makes it nonzero.
change_summary: Insert an assignment writing _sequenceNumber into the public state variable sequenceNumber before the existing require statement.
